name: Transbank Webpay Plus

webhook.algorithm: NONE — Transbank has NO webhooks. Flow is: POST /transactions to create, redirect the buyer, receive a POST back to return_url carrying `token_ws`, then MANDATORY `PUT /rswebpaytransaction/api/webpay/v1.2/transactions/{token}` to commit. An uncommitted transaction is reversed automatically. Generating a webhook handler for Transbank is a correctness bug, not a gap.

evidence.note: Catalog import from adversarially-checked research. The scheme above is quoted from that research and has NOT been transcribed into typed fields, so PagoKit will not generate a verifier. Promoting this provider to generic or build means reading the provider docs and typing the scheme in.

credentials.note: Paired headers `Tbk-Api-Key-Id` (commerce code) and `Tbk-Api-Key-Secret` (API key). Public integration credentials exist for the sandbox. No `sk_`-style prefix — does not fit secret_key_pattern.

onboarding.note: Chilean entity and a commercial agreement required.

fees.notes: UNKNOWN. Transbank pricing is set per merchant contract and by the Chilean interchange regime; no public flat rate verified. Do not populate.

notes: Transbank does NOT send webhooks. Webpay Plus redirects the buyer back with a token and the merchant must commit it. An uncommitted transaction auto-reverses, so a missing commit is a money-loss bug that presents as 'the payment just failed'. Prefer the official SDK's getTransactionResult(), which fetches and acknowledges in one call, over a hand-rolled PUT. Deadline and endpoint above still need verification against Transbank's current docs before this provider is promoted past 'advise'.

Chile is effectively a Transbank monopoly for card acquiring; almost no Chilean e-commerce ships without Webpay Plus. Nothing currently in providers.json serves CL beyond Mercado Pago. Critically, it is the provider that most breaks PagoKit's webhook-shaped generator.

SDKs: Official first-party SDKs maintained under the TransbankDevelopers GitHub org for PHP, Node, Python, Ruby, Java and .NET, plus official Magento/WooCommerce/PrestaShop plugins. Strong SDK coverage.
Developer-experience scores are unrated placeholders (3/3); they are not used in ranking.
Overlaps: Only real option for CL card acquiring. Complements fintoc/khipu (A2A bank transfer) rather than competing.
Onboarding: application_review. Chilean entity and a commercial agreement required.

commit_required.on_timeout: The transaction auto-reverses. Treat an uncommitted token as UNKNOWN, never as failed, and reconcile it against Transbank's status API before telling the buyer anything.
